name: Barycentric Interpolation on Tetrahedra
definition: Interpolation within a tetrahedron (3-simplex) using 3D barycentric coordinates, extending 2D barycentric coordinates by relating four tetrahedral subvolumes.
summary: Barycentric interpolation on tetrahedra computes scalar values inside a tetrahedron by weighting vertex data using volume ratios, offering a direct geometric alternative to hexahedral trilinear blending.
